transcript.text: I can certainly help you with that. The most common reason a washing machine won't spin is that it hasn't drained the water first, often due to a blockage in the pump filter or hose. It could also be as simple as an unbalanced load or a programme setting that prevents spinning. To start, please check if there are any items like a single heavy towel or duvet stuck to one side of the drum and try spreading them out evenly. Then, run a spin-only cycle with the drum empty to see if it spins up properly without any clothes inside.
its just one thing in there, a big heavy rubber backed bath mat on its own. it drained ok, no water left, just the mat soaking wet

Since the water has drained and you have only one heavy item, the machine is likely refusing to spin because the load is unbalanced or the programme settings are preventing it. Could you please check if your selected cycle includes a high-speed spin option, as some programmes like 'Delicate' or 'Wool' will skip the final spin? Also, try adding a few dry towels to the drum with the mat to help balance the weight before running another test. If that doesn't work, I'll need the make and model number of your washing machine to look up specific details for you. This is usually found on a sticker inside the door rim or on the back of the door, but if you can't reach it right now, we can leave it until later.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
its on the normal 1000 spin, not no spin. i put a couple of towels in with the mat and did rinse & spin and it spun up fine, mat came out damp not dripping. so is it ok??

Yes, your washing machine is perfectly fine! It was just struggling with the heavy bath mat on its own, which threw off the balance during the spin cycle. To stop this from happening again, try to avoid washing single heavy items like mats or duvets by themselves; adding a few towels helps balance the load and lets it spin properly. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
